---
title: Lecture overview
---

Each class has a set of required readings that should be **completed in your own
time**. For the most part, these readings will mirror what we have covered in
the lectures. However, there will be times that I find a cool resource that
I believe may be helpful for some of you.

All the slides for this module are special HTML files made using both
[Quarto](https://quarto.org/) and [Clean Revealjs theme](https://github.com/grantmcdermott/quarto-revealjs-clean) by [Grant McDermott](https://github.com/grantmcdermott).
Personally, this is my favourite theme to use for presentations, although I
have made a couple of minor tweaks to it myself
